ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled Task Creation Masquerading as System Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of scheduled tasks that involve system processes, which may indicate malicious actors masquerading as or abusing these processes to execute payloads or maintain persistence.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ audiodg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ conhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ dwm\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ explorer.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ lsass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ lsm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ mmc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ msiexec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ regsvr32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ services.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ spoolsv.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ svchost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ taskeng.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ taskhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ wininit.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ winlogon.*"))))
